summary: Saudi airstrikes continue across multiple Yemeni provinces with reported attacks on Ad Daliyah, Al Hudaydah, Marib, and Al Jawf. Houthi forces have reportedly gained control of strategic areas including the port city of Al-Mokha and the island of Mayun in Bab el-Mandeb. Tensions escalate as regional actors including Turkey, Pakistan, and Saudi Arabia sign a defense agreement, while Iran faces renewed IAEA scrutiny over nuclear compliance.
key_points: Saudi airstrikes reportedly hit Ad Daliyah with more than 40 sorties against Houthi forces in Al-Dhihaba, Marib, and Al-Jufra (Source: @asafroz/53290).
Yemeni army conducted 64 airstrikes across Ad Daliyah, Al Hudaydah, Marib, and Al Jawaf using F15 and Typhoon aircraft from King Fahd and King Khalid bases (Source: @naya_foriraq/90081).
Houthi forces reportedly captured strategic port city of Al-Mokha and island of Mayun in Bab el-Mandeb (Source: @yediotnews25/134894, @presstv/206232).
Turkey, Saudi Arabia, and Pakistan signed the 'Makkah Defense Pact' for three-way security cooperation (Source: @kianmeli1/91753).
IAEA Board referred Iran's nuclear case to UN Security Council after finding violations of non-proliferation obligations (Source: @VahidOnline/78302).
Trump threatened military action against 'Mount Kincaid' site, stating potential strikes on facilities beneath (Source: @kianmeli1/91746).
Saudi oil production fell to lowest level in 36 years during August as US military actions disrupted regional export routes (Source: @SharghDaily/182951).

Iran reportedly uses extensive oil-for-credit barter system with China to bypass Western sanctions, transferring $2-2.5 billion through hidden commercial mechanisms avoiding international banking channels (Source: @kianmeli1/91754).

Iranian officials claim no control over Houthis while reports indicate Tehran directed Houthi attacks, with Revolutionary Guard Corps showing signs of movement at Mount Kincaid site (Source: @rodast_omiddana/80671).

China opposed reimposing UN sanctions on Iran at Security Council, calling it divisive and illegal, noting previous council ended Iran nuclear file review without authorization for 90-day report (Source: @SharghDaily/182956).

Israeli Defense Minister stated any attack on Israel will receive strong response and Iranian energy facilities will also be targeted, with Israeli army on high alert for mission execution (Source: @kianmeli1/91755).

key_developments: Saudi airstrikes conducted 64 sorties across Ad Daliyah, Al Hudaydah, Marib, and Al Jawaf using F15 and Typhoon aircraft launched from King Fahd and King Khalid bases, with Yemeni forces successfully repelling Houthi formations in Ad Daliyah using locally-made surface-to-air missiles (Source: @naya_foriraq/90081).

Houthi forces reportedly gained control of strategic port city of Al-Mokha and island of Mayun in Bab el-Mandeb, positioning for potential maritime blockade operations against Saudi and Israeli shipping lanes (Source: @yediotnews25/134894, @presstv/206232).

IAEA Board of Governors referred Iran's nuclear case to UN Security Council after finding violations of non-proliferation obligations, potentially enabling reimposition of international sanctions (Source: @VahidOnline/78302).
Turkey, Saudi Arabia, and Pakistan signed formal 'Makkah Defense Pact' for three-way security cooperation, marking significant regional military alliance development (Source: @kianmeli1/91753).
Trump threatened military action against 'Mount Kincaid' site, stating potential strikes on facilities beneath following identification of activities at the location (Source: @kianmeli1/91746).
Saudi oil production fell to lowest level in 36 years during August as US military actions disrupted regional export routes and created shipping chaos (Source: @SharghDaily/182951).
Regional tensions escalate with Pakistan issuing direct warning to Tehran regarding Houthi proxy activities, activating Saudi-Pakistan-Turkey defense triangle (Source: @yediotnews25/134894).
sections.threat_assessment: Regional escalation continues with Saudi airstrikes intensifying across multiple Yemeni provinces. Houthi control of strategic port facilities creates potential maritime chokepoint threats to global energy shipments. IAEA referral of Iran's nuclear case to UNSC signals potential for renewed sanctions regime. Trump's threats against Iranian facilities indicate possible direct US military action. Regional defense alliances like Makkah Pact suggest hardening of conflict lines.
sections.regional_response: Pakistan issued direct warning to Iran regarding Houthi activities, activating defense triangle with Saudi Arabia and Turkey. China opposed reimposition of UN sanctions on Iran at Security Council, calling it divisive and illegal. Britain and Israel requested emergency UN Security Council meeting regarding Houthi attacks on Saudi territory. Regional oil production disruptions reaching 36-year lows indicate economic warfare dimensions. Maritime security concerns mounting over Bab el-Mandeb strait control.
sections.intelligence_notes: Houthi consolidation in Al-Mokha and Mayun island represents strategic shift toward maritime interdiction capabilities. Iranian nuclear compliance violations now subject to formal UN Security Council process after 20-year period. Regional defense cooperation expanding beyond traditional bilateral arrangements. Saudi oil infrastructure vulnerability exposed through production declines. Potential for direct US-Iran military confrontation increasing through public statements and military posturing.
